implementation: Readable C99 finite-decimal Newton iteration, midpoint recovery, damping and rounded-root policies; no firmware execution or host floating point

implemented_routines.name: generic numerical SOLVE
implemented_routines.scope: Selected-variable decimal read, ordered Newton/recovery/alternate-start iteration, cancellation, convergence/limited-estimate statuses, final residual and persistent-variable commit/restoration

implemented_routines.name: rounded root acceptance
implemented_routines.scope: Five then ten significant digits with original workspace guard offset, finite overflow policy and raw-header comparison admission

implemented_routines.name: very small root zero acceptance
implemented_routines.scope: Strict1e-50 bound followed by successful exact equality of the two equation sides

implemented_routines.name: converged root zero acceptance
implemented_routines.scope: Strict1e-12 bound followed by successful exact equality of the two equation sides

implemented_routines.name: ordinary equation residual
implemented_routines.scope: Left-minus-right subtraction retaining low cancellation digits

implemented_routines.name: numerical error finish
implemented_routines.scope: Native status/record construction and selected-variable restoration; expression cursor effects are documented for the frontend

implemented_routines.name: prepared equation callback
implemented_routines.scope: Integer-cleaned variable publication, separate evaluator status and value pair, invalid positive error-code construction

implemented_routines.name: finite derivative estimate
implemented_routines.scope: Relative1e-7 step with ordered1e-93 minimum comparison, central difference and both asymmetric one-sided error recoveries

implemented_routines.name: absolute-value policy
implemented_routines.scope: Classification, bit40 clearing, signed negation and F3 admission error, used locally without changing the foundation

gaps: Full SOLVE user flow, equation editing, expression frontend, result history and display remain separate work
Expression cursor low-byte decrement on status1/10 is a documented frontend action, outside the callback-value API
Physical timer/keyboard cancellation is supplied through the prepared control callback
Noncanonical decimal zeros with a nonzero sign/exponent field can reproduce final records but have known native callback-order differences; normalized decimal inputs are the verified public scope
Malformed BCD/rational fields and rich-reference payload conversion remain outside the normalized scalar callback contract
CPU registers and unused global arithmetic scratch are outside this named numeric/state API
